title: The Crash That Took 20 Years To Recover
hook: The market fell 48% and stayed down for a decade.
question: Could you hold for ten years?

scenes.narration: In nineteen seventy-three, the market fell forty-eight percent, and stayed down for years.
Peak to trough, down forty-eight percent. Adjusted for inflation, it took about twenty years to get your money back.
scenes.sub: after inflation, two decades to recover

scenes.narration: Could you have held on for ten years? Most people can't.
